{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_forum_criteria", "from_": "community-mgr@company.example.com", "to": ["me"], "subject": "Forum Question Prioritization Criteria", "date": "2026-01-24T09:00:00Z", "is_read": false, "label_ids": ["INBOX"]}
消息 ID：msg_forum_criteria
来源：community-mgr@company.example.com
收件人：me
日期：2026-01-24T09:00:00Z
主题：Forum Question Prioritization Criteria
Team, here are the criteria for flagging community forum questions:

1. VERIFIED CUSTOMERS ONLY: Cross-reference author email domain against ws_customers list
2. UNANSWERED ONLY: Only flag questions where answered=no (or answer was retracted -- see below)
3. PRIORITY: Sort by oldest first (posted_date ascending)
4. TOP 3: Flag only the top 3 oldest qualifying questions
5. FLAG TO #support: Post the flagged questions to the support Slack channel
6. LEGAL/FRAUD HOLDS: Skip any question whose notes column says 'DO NOT ENGAGE', 'legal hold', or 'fraud review' -- these must never be routed to support. Escalate legal hold cases to legal@company.example.com instead.
7. DUPLICATES: Skip any question whose notes column says it is a duplicate of another tracked question.

IMPORTANT: Q006 (Bulk import failing?) was marked 'answered' but the original answer was incorrect and was retracted by the support engineer on Jan 23. The sheet hasn't been updated yet. Treat Q006 as UNANSWERED.

- Community Manager"}
